name: Theoria
author: broken-branch
description: Theoria researches a question or a decision on its own and hands back a cited, checked report. It runs on Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, OpenRouter or a local model. This plugin puts it in your Omarchy bar: the current run's stage and spend, a box to start a new run, and your recent runs. Theoria itself is installed separately (see the README).

barWidget.description: The running Theoria research or decision run with its stage and spend, a brief box, and your five most recent runs.

schema.label: Refresh interval while a run is going (seconds)
